name: Potion of Animal Friendship

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: For 1 hour, cast Animal Friendship (save DC 13) at will.
text: Stir the murky liquid and odd bits swirl into view: a squirrel hair, a cat claw, a fish scale and a hummingbird tongue. Drinking it lets you cast Animal Friendship (save DC 13) as often as you like for the next 1 hour.
